settings.title: Settings
settings.navAgentHint: Providers, models, and API keys for the built-in assistant.
settings.navMcpHint: Register NodeShell with other agents, set session limits, and choose who confirms MCP tools.
settings.mcpHint: Limits idle disconnect and concurrency for Agent SSH via MCP. Tool confirmation is separate from the built-in assistant.
settings.mcpRegisterHint: Writes NodeShell into each Agent’s user-global MCP config without removing other servers. Registers the native executable with the --mcp flag.
settings.mcpOtherHint: Merge this stdio server named nodeshell into the client’s MCP config. Do not replace other servers.
settings.mcpPasteVscode: VS Code: workspace .vscode/mcp.json, or the user mcp.json under the VS Code profile
settings.agentHint: Add OpenAI-compatible providers. Each has its own base URL, model list, and API key (stored in your OS keyring, never in the settings file).
settings.agentModelsMeta: Press Enter or comma to add; paste multiple model IDs
settings.mcpPermissionExternalHint: The MCP client (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and others) asks the user. NodeShell still checks paths, host keys, sessions, and arguments.
settings.mcpPermissionLocalHint: NodeShell shows a system confirmation dialog for commands, remote writes, uploads, and downloads. Paths, host keys, sessions, and arguments are still checked.
settings.permissionsHint: Applies only to the built-in sidebar assistant when it runs a command, writes a remote file, or transfers a file. External MCP clients use the MCP tool confirmation setting.
